SameerKumar PandaDriven by a passion for building scalable, high-performance systems and advancing Generative AI,I bring a strong foundation in designing, developing, and deploying distributed software solutionsto solve complex problems. My expertise spans architecting fault-tolerant microservices,optimizing algorithms for efficiency, and integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), ModelContext Protocol (MCP), and other advanced machine learning systems into productionenvironments. Skilled in Python, Java, C++, cloud platforms, and modern DevOps practices, Iexcel at delivering customer-focused, reliable, and maintainable applications—leveraging LLMs,RAG pipelines, MCP workflows, and prompt engineering to enhance intelligence, adaptability,and automation at scale.WebsitesSKILLSProfessional Experience & ImpactMachine Learning EngineerTiger Analytics, Hyderabad, IndiaOctober 2023-CurrentHyderabad, Telangana 500019+919102292779sameer.krpanda@gmail.com

LinkedIn

GitHub

Leetcode

Programming Languages: Python, Java,C++, SQL, PySpark

Web & API Development: FastAPI, Flask,Django, REST APIs

Machine Learning Algorithms: TiDE,SARIMAX, Prophet, XGBoost, DeepAR,LSTM, Lasso Regression, Classification,Recommendation Systems, SentimentAnalysis

Deep Learning & NLP: TensorFlow,PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain,LangGraph, LLAMA3, LoRA, DPO,Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG),Prompt Engineering

Data Engineering: ETL Pipelines, DataPreprocessing, Feature Engineering

Databases & Storage: MongoDB, Redis,Vector Databases (FAISS, Weaviate)

Cloud & DevOps: Azure ML Studio, AWSTextract, Docker, GitHub, GitHub Actions,CI/CD, Linux, System Design

Testing & Optimization: AutomatedTesting, Model Evaluation (Accuracy,Precision, Recall, F1-score), PerformanceBenchmarking, Load Testing

Tools & Visualization: Matplotlib,Seaborn, Plotly, Tableau, Power BI

Core CS Competencies: Data Structures &Algorithms (DSA), Object-OrientedProgramming (OOP), Scalability, FaultTolerance, Distributed Systems

Engineered and deployed scalable TiDE forecasting microservices (SARIMAX, Prophet, XGBoost,DeepAR, LSTM) using Python, Docker, and Azure ML—achieving up to 90% KPI accuracy gainswhile ensuring reliability, observability, and global readiness.

Architected an agentic RAG pipeline using LangGraph & LangChain with advanced featureengineering (lags, seasonality, external regressors), reducing manual forecasting effort by 95%,designed for fault tolerance and ultra-low latency.

Built and productionized fine-tuning pipelines for LLAMA3 (LoRA, DPO) with rigorous prompt

SDE InternPolynomial.ai, Remote, IndiaFebruary 2023-July 2023EducationIIIT Bhubaneswar at Bhubaneswar, OdishaB.Tech in Information TechnologyAugust 2023GPA: 7.82 / 10ProjectsJOB.ai – Automated Job Aggregation & Recommendation Platform

AI_JOB_ASSITANTTech Stack: Python, FastAPI, FAISS, MongoDB, Docker, Telegram Bot API, REST APIs, Parallel Processing,Data Cleaning PipelinesAccomplishmentsvalidation to minimize hallucinations, aligned with secure and compliant deployment practices.Developed RESTful microservices for AI assistants (healthcare tracking) using FastAPI, Redis,VectorDBs—leveraging recommendation systems and NLP (classification, sentiment analysis)—structured for modularity, performance, and maintainability.

Automated CI/CD processes using GitHub Actions, Docker, and Azure ML, integrating modelvalidation metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1), load testing, and performance dashboards tosupport robust development cycles and platform stability.

Designed and deployed a distributed real-time audio-to-text pipeline using AWS Textract, FastAPI,and Docker—reducing end-to-end latency by 90% while ensuring high throughput and faulttolerance for time-critical workloads.

Optimized an entity extraction microservice (TensorFlow, Python, Redis) through algorithmrefactoring and data-access optimizations, improving processing speed by 92% and enablingnear-real-time document parsing at scale.

Built a recommendation engine for automated invoice/POS data processing (MongoDB, Django,REST APIs), reducing manual workforce requirements by 82% and improving operational efficiencyacross multiple business units.

Enhanced an AI bot for automated property description generation, improving NLP modelefficiency by 82% through caching strategies, batch inference optimization, and modular servicedesign.

Designed and deployed a distributed, fully automated job aggregation platform scraping fromLinkedIn, Naukri, Instahyre, and other sources in parallel, reducing job data ingestion time by 99%.

Built scalable ETL pipelines for JSON normalization, data cleaning, deduplication, and schemaunification—ensuring high-quality datasets for downstream processing.

Implemented semantic search capabilities using FAISS vector databases for fast, context-aware jobmatching, enabling sub-second query responses.

Developed a Telegram bot interface to deliver personalized job recommendations, integrated withMongoDB for persistent storage of user profiles, CVs, and interaction history.

Automated application support workflows to generate tailored referral emails, cover letters, and coldoutreach templates, improving candidate application efficiency by ~80%.

Containerized and orchestrated the entire system using Docker for reproducible deployments andhigh availability in production.

2nd Place – Tiger Analytics Agentic AI Hackathon – Built and deployed an advanced Agentic AIworkflow integrating LLMs, RAG, and automation pipelines for real-world business use cases.

5★★★★ – Cleared all milestones in the Tiger Analytics MLE Program.

1585 / 34K – Facebook Hacker Cup (Round 2).

1996th & 2448th – Google Kickstart (Round F & B).

144th / 8K – CodeChef Short Challenge.
